title: USANA Introduces 3-in-1 Protein, Creatine, and Electrolyte Drink Mix
summary: Many active adults use separate products for protein, creatine, and hydration—adding cost, complexity, and extra steps to their daily routines. To simplify that routine, USANA Health Sciences (NYSE: USNA) today announced the launch of Clear Protein + Creatine Mix, bringing all three—clear whey protein isolate, micronized creatine monohydrate, and electrolytes—into one refreshing, 50-calorie drink.
